notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence medium): Benilla's ItemRef.xml is the chat-link click router: SetItemRef parses |Hitem:| / |Hplayer:| payloads, shows a standalone ItemRefTooltip (persistent tooltip with corner close), whispers on player-link left-click, opens the FRIEND dropdown on right-click, and shift-inserts into the chat editbox. MSUIClient's chat (Program.Chat.cs / ChatFrameLaw) renders messages as plain text: no hyperlink escape parsing, no clickable links, no ItemRefTooltip window, no player-name click menu. Greps for SetItemRef/Hyperlink/ItemRef across the repo return nothing UI-related.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: Confidence medium only because link text may never be emitted by MSUI's own chat pipeline in the first place; if server-sent item links arrive they render as raw escape codes.
